minor.issue: First attempt at ~6600-char TTS returned 502 (ingress upstream timeout) — OpenAI TTS generation on ~4000 chars can exceed the gateway timeout. Retest at 5040 chars succeeded. Consider a client-side chunking hint or a shorter server-side cap (e.g. 2000 chars for landing/demo use-cases) to reduce 502 risk under load. Not a functional bug; the truncation logic is correct.

ui_bugs.issue: Review request states 'The verified certificate page /verify/SAMPLE-ITHR-2026-001 renders the CertificateTutor' — but Verify.jsx does NOT include <CertificateTutor/>. CertificateTutor renders only on the AUTHENTICATED /certificate/:certId route (Certificate.jsx). Either (a) mount CertificateTutor at the bottom of the successful Verify.jsx render (public visitors + credential holders both benefit from voice-Aletheia), OR (b) update the review-spec wording to reference /certificate/:certId. On /certificate/:certId the tutor + testids all render correctly.

action_items: Decide whether CertificateTutor should also be mounted on the PUBLIC /verify/:certId route (Verify.jsx). Currently it only lives on /certificate/:certId (protected). If yes, add <CertificateTutor certificate={result} /> after the verified card in Verify.jsx.
Consider capping TTS input at ~2000 chars (or documenting the 502 risk) — 4000-char generation can hit the ingress timeout. Current 4000-cap is functionally correct but marginal.
critical_code_review_comments: voice_router.py — Clean, ~110 lines. Uses emergentintegrations OpenAI STT/TTS wrappers. Endpoints intentionally open (no auth) which is fine for MVP but leaves cost-abuse surface open — the file comment already notes this. Consider a light IP-based rate-limit (5 req / 60s) before production scale-up.

voice_router.py:87-88 — Truncation to 3997 + '…' is a nice touch but the length ceiling of 4000 chars combined with OpenAI TTS latency (~30-50s at that size) is close to the Cloudflare 60s upstream timeout. Recommend cutting the cap to 2000 chars OR splitting into multiple TTS requests + concatenating client-side.

useVoiceIO.js:44 — MediaRecorder blob<500 bytes threshold ignores silent taps → sensible UX. The .name = filename hint on BytesIO in voice_router.py:54 is correct — Whisper needs a filename to sniff MIME.

VoiceControls.jsx — Correctly disables the speaker when there is no lastAssistantText; the 'voice-enabled' label is present on all 3 surfaces; testids follow the {surface}-voice-{mic|speaker} convention consistently.

Verify.jsx — Does NOT mount CertificateTutor. If the intent per iteration description is 'voice-interactive Aletheia on 3 surfaces: certificate page, in-lesson tutor, landing demo' then 'certificate page' currently only means the OWNER's /certificate/:certId view. Public verifiers on /verify/:certId will not see it. Confirm product intent.
CertificateTutor.jsx auto-speak logic (setAutoplayNext + spokenIdRef) correctly gates on !streaming so it doesn't cut off mid-stream — good. Same pattern replicated in InlineTutor + DemoChat.
Backend admin users endpoint /api/admin/users returns password_hash-excluded docs but the current cap is limit=500 — for orgs beyond that a paginated cursor would be needed. Non-blocking at 84 users.

rca of the issue: N/A — 11/11 backend green, 3/4 frontend surfaces green. Only observation: Verify.jsx (public verify page) does not mount CertificateTutor, while review-spec expected it there. Root cause: CertificateTutor is imported/used in Certificate.jsx (/certificate/:certId, protected) NOT in Verify.jsx (/verify/:certId, public).
